tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Analyst | Techno-Functional Expert with 5+ Years in SAP Commerce
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong functional analysis, configuration, and integration expertise across PIM, ERP and MDM. Proven record in designing OCC REST APIs, data pipelines, and supporting production in agile, international teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with AI-assisted development experience.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Analyst
cover_en.hook: I am excited by the opportunity to join Andrew Hunt because of its reputation for innovative SAP Commerce solutions. With over five years of hands-on experience delivering Hybris projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep functional and technical expertise to drive your commerce initiatives.

bullets.label: Functional Design
bullets.text: Led functional design and configuration of SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) at Rockwell, translating business requirements into custom data models, OCC APIs and PIM-ERP integrations.

bullets.label: Integration Expertise
bullets.text: Implemented end-to-end PIM-to-Hybris pipelines using Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders, ensuring synchronized product data across global channels.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Worked directly with international business and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, write user stories and functional specs, and support UAT.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Provided production troubleshooting and performance tuning for SAP Commerce platforms, reducing incident resolution time and improving system stability.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, holds a valid German work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available to start 16 December 2026.

tailoring.why_company: I am excited by Andrew Hunt’s commitment to delivering cutting-edge SAP Commerce solutions that empower global brands. Your focus on seamless B2B/B2C integration and innovative functional design aligns perfectly with my experience driving complex Hybris configurations and PIM-ERP integrations at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Joining your team would let me contribute immediately to your ambitious roadmap.
tailoring.motivation_short: Passionate about shaping robust SAP Commerce experiences, I seek to apply my techno-functional expertise to drive Andrew Hunt’s commerce innovations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Analyst with 5+ years delivering integrations and configurations at Rockwell and Shell. I’d love to discuss how I can add value to Andrew Hunt’s team.
tailoring.offer: I will accelerate your SAP Commerce platform by optimizing OCC APIs and streamlining PIM-ERP data pipelines, leveraging my proven experience at Rockwell Automation. Within the first months I can deliver stable integrations and improve production support processes.
tailoring.email_subject: Application for SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Analyst – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, I am Kranti Chavan, a SAP Commerce (Hybris) Functional Analyst with over five years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I am drawn to Andrew Hunt’s innovative approach to commerce platforms and its focus on seamless B2B/B2C integration. I can bring immediate value through proven OCC API development, PIM-ERP integration, and production support expertise. I also noted your emphasis on functional configuration, where my techno-functional background will excel. Please find my CV and cover letter attached.
